title: Your workspaces
intro: Work together privately on a problem. Only explicitly invited members have access.
name: Working title
memberHelp: Contributors edit their own entries. Owners can delete entries but cannot rewrite other people’s statements. Viewers can only read.
inviteHelp: Access starts only after signing in with the verified invited email address and accepting. The invitation grants no other CONNECT permissions.
failed: Not sent. You can share the personal link.
rotate: Create and send a new link
rotateHelp: A new link replaces the old one. Wait at least a minute before rotating again.
claimHelp: Accept with the account for the invited, verified email address. You gain access only to this private workspace.
invalid: The invitation has expired, was revoked or used, or does not match your verified email address.
error: The action could not be completed. Check your input and access, and reload the page if needed.
sourceHelp: Sources provide context, not proof of validation. They are not fetched automatically.
emptyEntries: What do you observe? What do you already know? What is still an assumption? Which perspectives are missing? What could you try next?
freeOrder: These are prompts, not required steps. Start with any entry.
noneType: No entries of this type yet.
archiveCheck: End editing and revoke pending invitations
archiveHelp: Archived workspaces remain readable by authorized members. New entries and invitations are disabled. Access can still be removed.
privacy: Nothing here is automatically published: no names, entries or sources.
sourceNotice: This workspace links to your existing active problem. The problem stays unchanged; nothing from this workspace flows back automatically.
inviteDisclosure: You can revoke invitations or remove members. Previously read content cannot be recalled.

hints.observation: What was actually seen or experienced?
hints.perspective: How does an affected person or group describe the problem?
hints.assumption: What do we suspect but not yet know?
hints.test: What could we try to learn something?
